title: Adding Service Parts renames the first field and copies the person
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has {Sales-rep-A} as its one sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Starting screen: {Customer-A}'s page is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open Edit Customer and hover over the + beside Sales Representative.
  2. Click the +.
  3. Click "Sales Representative - Service Parts".
  4. Click the + again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the tooltip reads "Add representative".
  • Step 2: the menu lists, in this order, "Sales Representative - Service Parts" and "Sales Representative - Part Sales".
  • Step 3: the first field is renamed "Sales Representative - Service Labor" and "Sales Representative - Service Parts" shows under it. Both read {Sales-rep-A}. No dropdown opens on its own; Service Parts has a remove x.
  • Step 4: the menu now lists only "Sales Representative - Part Sales".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S4-R5, S4-R6, S4-R7, S4-R10, S4-R15, read 19 Oct 2026. Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), page 2 (cited by the story), export read 19 Oct 2026, used for on-screen labels; the look itself is checked in the "Design — how it looks" cases. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R5: “The + button of S2-R1 to S2-R3 sits to the right of the first field, with the tooltip "Add representative".”
  • S4-R6: “Its menu lists, in this order, each field not yet added: "Sales Representative - Service Parts" and "Sales Representative - Part Sales". When both are added the + is not shown.”
  • S4-R7: “Adding Service Parts renames the first field "Sales Representative - Service Labor" and shows "Sales Representative - Service Parts" under it. Both start with the person who was in the first field, or "Unassigned".”
  • S4-R10: “Service Parts and Part Sales each have the remove x of S2-R8 to their right, with the tooltip "Remove Sales Representative - Service Parts" or "Remove Sales Representative - Part Sales". The first field has the + instead, while there is something left to add, and otherwise no button.”
  • S4-R15: “Neither dropdown opens on its own after a field is added.”
